# Camp Resource: Mothman Nest

Your C.A.M.P. has been blessed by the Mothman who rewards you with his eggs.

- Collects Mothman Eggs over time -

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Mothman Nest__

**Produces**

Mothman Eggs

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

4 Mothman Eggs

**Obtainable via**

Halloween Challenge 2023 Reward - Free

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

None

#### **Flamingo Units**

2x Flamingo Units
